My tubers — I plant mostly cassava with some yam — they can still give good harvest if I prepare the ridges well and weed on time. I will buy small fertilizer because the soil here is getting tired, but I cannot afford much. For the heavy work of making ridges and harvesting, my wife and I cannot do it alone, I must call some boys from the village to help me.
